outcome: Visual Analog Scale (VAS) at uterine contraction
cohort: 674 patients who received Nalbuphine or Sufentanil Patient-Controlled Intravenous Analgesia (PCIA) after CS between 1 January 2018 and 30 November 2020
finding: Compared to Sufentanil, Nalbuphine may provide better analgesia for uterine contraction pain after cesarean section.
mod_finding: Nalbuphine may provide better analgesia for uterine contraction pain after cesarean section, especially in multiparous women.
